'''Ryoo Finn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] who lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Finn got addicted to [[Salt/Legends|salt]], a substance that is addictive and potentially deadly to members of his species. To combat his addiction, he was brought to the [[Arcona Compound]] in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] on the jungle world [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a camp for salt addicts. He arrived at the camp in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and had trouble adjusting to the place.

It turned out that he had brought a secret stash of salt with him but lost it near the [[mouf]] dens in the jungle. Some of the moufs came after Finn and he dropped his salt when he ran away. In the following days, he became increasingly agitated due to the lust for salt. [[Brody Johnson|Johnson Smith]] noticed his behavior and asked an adventurer to find out what bothered Finn, as Finn wouldn't have told him or [[Jerrol Chupapa]] - the Arcona running the camp. Finn told the adventurer about his lost stash and the adventurer agreed to search for it in the jungles. The adventurer eventually found it and brought it to Smith who promised to help Finn with his addiction.

==Behind the scenes==
Ryoo Finn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. Johnson Smith asked the player to talk to Finn. Then, the player had to find Finn's bag of salt, which was lying in the jungle nearby.
